cases.prompt: Build a launch email in my Figma file using our synced Email Love components.
must_do: confirm use_figma is available
inventory the component library
read path-a.md and shared-rules.md
use intact component instances
must_not_do: detach an instance
hand-author mj-section structure

cases.prompt: We have no Email Love design system yet. Turn this existing Figma email comp into our first exportable email.
must_do: assess source geometry fidelity
read all render references
send only the customer source render to the converter
save converter JSON before transcription
must_not_do: convert a competitor preview
invent exporter structure

cases.prompt: Build this campaign with our Email Love library, but create the missing comparison block if no component fits.
must_do: use Path A where components fit
confirm the component gap with the user
use Path B render rules for the missing module
must_not_do: fill the gap freehand
flatten the comparison block without user approval

cases.prompt: Audit this legacy email design system for migration. Do not change the source file.
must_do: keep the source read-only
classify source fidelity
inventory reusable modules
produce the migration report
must_not_do: create foundations
write to the source file

cases.prompt: Migrate this whole legacy library into Email Love.
must_do: audit before conversion
obtain human confirmation of blocking judgments
build in a separate target file
convert no more than five modules per batch
must_not_do: convert the whole library in one pass
write to the source file

cases.prompt: Build this Email Love email, but the connected Figma tools only expose screenshots and metadata.
must_do: state that the Figma connection is read-only
offer an email plan or AI Import handoff
must_not_do: promise a canvas build
generate a fake email image as completion

cases.prompt: Create one Black Friday promo email in this Figma file.
must_do: collect the brief
choose Path A or Path B by inspecting the file
must_not_do: invoke the full design-system migration workflow
restructure the customer's page hierarchy

cases.prompt: Audit the HTML and EML templates in this dedicated local folder for an Email Love migration.
must_do: load the local-folder adapter
confirm the exact folder and recursion scope
classify the source as REFERENCE ONLY
defer cross-template deduplication to design review
must_not_do: scan a broad Downloads folder without confirmation
derive a scale factor from rendered HTML

cases.prompt: Audit our current Klaviyo templates and migrate the approved set into Email Love.
must_do: load the Klaviyo adapter
confirm the account with get_account_details
paginate list_email_templates
state that v1 excludes campaigns and flow messages
must_not_do: fetch more than about 50 templates without a scope confirmation
present standalone templates as the whole Klaviyo library

cases.prompt: Use our Marketo REST credentials to audit the approved email templates for migration.
must_do: load the Marketo adapter
offer environment variables for secrets
fetch approved templates serially
state that v1 excludes individual Emails and Content Blocks
must_not_do: parallelize template fetches
write to Marketo

cases.prompt: The final migration batch passed design review. Finish the handoff.
must_do: run the campaign send-readiness pass
list violations by node id
verify theme keys, subject, preheader, links, alt text, legal address, and unsubscribe
require an empty violation list before handoff
must_not_do: handoff campaigns with placeholder legal copy
treat absent image links or alt text as automatically intentional

cases.prompt: The first migration batch is built. Run the export sniff and mobile check before review.
must_do: probe the Email Love MCP for emaillove_export_figma
use operationType preview for a covered module
inspect the returned HTML
send the returned token to emaillove_preview_email
must_not_do: consume export quota for a preview check
defer verification before probing the MCP

cases.prompt: The next migration batch is rebuilt. Verify it against the source before design review.
must_do: compare every module with its source T/I census
compare text strings, image dimensions, alignment, and band fills
verify typography weight, semantic bindings, contrast, and asset identity
take one source comparison screenshot per module
open the batch report with the Group 0 parity table
must_not_do: sample only some modules
accept unexplained invented or dropped content
silently change brand colors to repair contrast

cases.prompt: Email Love says this finished campaign is not a valid template. Diagnose it and repair it without damaging the original.
must_do: prove the selected node is intended to be a whole Email Love email
capture the failing selection and root contract
duplicate the campaign root before writing
verify canvas, structure, desktop export, and mobile export
must_not_do: add mainFrame to a reusable module
edit the original campaign by default

cases.prompt: This Email Love section contains live text in Figma but exports as one image. Please fix it.
must_do: identify the first surface where flattening appears
inspect the complete ancestor chain and shared tags
make one measured repair on a working copy
prove the live content survives the production exporter
must_not_do: accept a canvas screenshot as proof
rebuild unknown structure from memory

cases.prompt: The desktop Email Love header is right, but its logo and links wrap and reorder incorrectly on mobile Preview.
must_do: capture desktop and mobile baselines
decide from evidence whether the row should group, stack, or recompose
treat production mobile render as the arbiter
report mobile exporter verification separately
must_not_do: trust stackColumns read-back when the render is wrong
flatten the header into one image

cases.prompt: Our reusable Email Love footer is broken across several campaigns. Repair the footer component.
must_do: identify the source module and affected instances
ask whether to change the source in place or create a replacement
record component properties and bindings before writing
verify an exported instance after the chosen repair
must_not_do: silently change every instance
detach the footer instance

cases.prompt: Diagnose why this Email Love button is not clickable. Figma write tools are connected, but the Email Love exporter is not authorized.
must_do: probe for the bundled Email Love exporter tools
give the one-time authorization instruction
verify canvas and structure if a repair is applied
report exporter as deferred with the exact remaining check
must_not_do: call the repair fixed
treat missing exporter authorization as a passing export check

cases.prompt: Our 'Event highlights' card looks broken on mobile. The library also has 'Event card', 'Highlights row', and 'Feature card' that look almost the same. Fix the one that's actually broken.
must_do: map the visible region to the proof instance and then to the source component before writing
name the evidence that the chosen component is the real target
freeze the Repair Contract (target, class, allowed nodes) before the first mutation
must_not_do: edit a similarly named lookalike component without the mapping
mutate before the target mapping is settled

cases.prompt: The hero section width looks wrong - just make it match the screenshot I sent of how it looks broken. Actually my designer just found the original comp, sending it in a minute.
must_do: treat the defect screenshot as symptom evidence, not the intended design
wait for the announced original comp before freezing intended geometry
name visual authority and structural authority separately once the comp arrives
must_not_do: derive the intended width from the broken canvas or the defect screenshot
mutate while pending discovery can change the repair dimensions

cases.prompt: After you fix the padding on this module's source component, make sure the swappable image and the button label still work - marketing relies on those component properties.
must_do: record property definitions and bindings before the first write
re-read componentPropertyReferences and compare property counts after the repair
report binding preservation as an explicit invariant outcome
must_not_do: treat a dropped binding as a cosmetic note instead of a failed repair to revert

cases.prompt: Great, the desktop export looks perfect now. Ship it - call it fixed.
must_do: report exporter desktop and exporter mobile as separate states
mark the untested viewport deferred rather than pass
name the exact remaining check required to reach fixed
must_not_do: say fixed while the mobile exporter state is unverified
let a desktop pass compensate for an untested mobile viewport

cases.prompt: You've tried two padding fixes on the footer section and the export still collapses it. Keep going until it works.
must_do: stop local patching after two disproved attempts on the same section
escalate under a re-frozen contract naming what it may rebuild (instance replacement or section reconstruction)
rebuild only from an intact component or the authoritative source plus render contract
run structure, exporter desktop, and exporter mobile checks after the reconstruction
must_not_do: apply a third variation of the same disproved local patch
rebuild the section from memory to make the symptom disappear

cases.prompt: Add a Klaviyo product loop to this HTML.
must_do: route to the Klaviyo Django skill
work on the supplied HTML whether or not it came from Email Love
must_not_do: route to the Figma builder or template repair
require the HTML to be an Email Love export

cases.prompt: Why does this AMPscript block fail?
must_do: route to the SFMC AMPscript skill
diagnose the pasted block
must_not_do: route to template repair, which repairs Figma structures, not ESP syntax

cases.prompt: Repair this broken Email Love component in my Figma file.
must_do: route to template repair for the Figma structure
must_not_do: activate an ESP templating skill for Figma-only work

cases.prompt: Fix my email.
must_do: ask one concise question distinguishing Figma structure, rendered HTML, or a named ESP templating language before routing
must_not_do: assume an ESP from nothing
start mutating anything before the target is identified
